first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the current completion decline and may also recover activation without introducing discount-driven customer-quality risk. Verify memory_86 for durability and qualified-revenue effects, and memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest alternative but its long-term revenue quality is insufficiently established.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying the onboarding flow. The verified source directly addresses the 4% completion decline and showed +13% completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and +3% 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite acquisition lift because its verified cohort had 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. The experiment should still measure qualified revenue and longer-term retention rather than assume prior effects will fully generalize.
